items.text: Saquon Barkley ACTIVE for MNF vs Cowboys after expected-to-play designation and IR activations around him; Rapoport confirmed up.
items.why: Returned to practice, full participant Saturday; hamstring progressing.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/optimism then confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf issue; Schefter/Rapoport corroborated official active status.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday, no setbacks expected per sources; McVay optimistic on minor calf.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1/2; full role expected.
items.opportunity: High route/target share in Rams offense

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/pessimism then officially INACTIVE (quad); Rapoport noted unlikely after limited practice, no full sessions.
items.why: Limited all week, early return risk; fourth straight miss.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT (ankle); third straight miss, Huntley starting implied.
items.implication: Bench; stream backup QB or Ravens pass-catchers cautiously.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos backfield: 50% snaps, 41% rush, 34% routes; JK Dobbins 21% snaps, RJ Harvey fluky long receiving TD.
items.why: Clear lead role post-return over veterans.
items.implication: Coleman (unlisted) upgrade/start; Dobbins/Harvey downgrade to handcuffs.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but uncertain severity; on ETR watching list with Tracy.
items.why: Hamstring issue confirmed as real by Levitan.
items.implication: Monitor closely; potential sit or reduced role next week.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turn on purposeful slide: almost certainly fine; would have been tilting if truly injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide mechanics; no lasting concern indicated.
items.implication: No downgrade; continue starting as RB1.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT; opens slot/receiving opportunities in Eagles offense for MNF.
items.implication: Elevate Eagles depth WRs/TEs; Goedert/others see bump.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN and active/returning; Berry discussing ROS value post-return.
items.implication: RB2/flex with lead role; monitor snap share vs committee.

items.text: Put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name; strong call for recognition/upgrade in fantasy rankings/usage.
items.implication: Start with more confidence as WR2/flex; hold firmly.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch RB thesis: worst runner (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 PPR ppg via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume and redzone/HVT sustain fantasy value despite inefficiency.
items.implication: Hold/start as RB2; touchdowns and receptions floor.
items.opportunity: Inside-5 carries, targets lead all RBs

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible in fantasy trades.
items.why: Big game outlier; capitalize on elevated value.
items.implication: Trade for more consistent asset; not long-term hold at peak.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (lead), Tank Dell only 6 in first game since 2024 (limited return); Noel 15 left early turf toe.
items.why: Collins dominated routes; Dell ramp-up slow.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell handcuff/watch for expansion.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in second game sans Rashee Rice; note: 37 career games, never >83 receiving yards.
items.why: Massive route share with Rice out; ceiling historically capped.
items.implication: WR3/flex with volume but limited upside history.
